usage: The word "火箭" (fo2 zin3) is a noun and refers to a rocket, a vehicle used to travel into space or for launching objects.
"火箭" can be used as a subject in a sentence, e.g., "火箭發射咗。" (The rocket was launched.)
You can use "火箭" as a direct object after verbs related to launch or build, e.g., "我哋設計咗一個新火箭。" (We designed a new rocket.)
"火箭" can be modified by adjectives to describe types or sizes, e.g., "大火箭" (big rocket) or "快火箭" (fast rocket).
In casual conversation, "火箭" is commonly used in discussions about space, science, or futuristic topics.
